svg.title: Payment Module Detailed Current-State Architecture
svg.desc: Detailed current-state architecture for the RACPad Payment module, showing CDN delivery, Cognito/Okta-federated identity, API Gateway wiring, internal Lambda code layers (handlers, validators, use cases, shared library), downstream Enterprise Alt-Pay integration, and supporting platform/CI-CD controls.
